findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "openai-sora" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_v2_feed, get_v2_profile_feed, get_v2_post_details_and_replies, get_v2_post_remix_feed, get_v1_feed_home, get_v1_feed_images, get_v1_feed_videos, get_v1_feed_top, get_v1_post_details · Public sink: get_v2_post_details_and_replies, get_v2_post_remix_feed, get_v1_post_details.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_v2_feed, get_v2_profile_feed, get_v2_post_details_and_replies, get_v2_post_remix_feed, get_v1_feed_home, get_v1_feed_images, get_v1_feed_videos, get_v1_feed_top, get_v1_post_details · Public sink: get_v2_post_details_and_replies, get_v2_post_remix_feed, get_v1_post_details

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
